Based on my research of Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) data, I need to compile the information from the annual on-time arrival performance rankings for 2012, 2013, and 2014. Let me summarize what I found:

## Data Available from BTS:

**2014 Annual Rankings (Mountain & West Time Zones):**
| Airport | IATA Code | Time Zone | % On-Time 2014 | 2014 Rank |
|---------|-----------|-----------|----------------|-----------|
| Salt Lake City, UT | SLC | Mountain | 85.04% | 1 |
| Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Mountain | 83.79% | 2 |
| Seattle, WA | SEA | Pacific (West) | 83.41% | 3 |
| Portland, OR | PDX | Pacific (West) | 81.97% | 7 |
| Las Vegas, NV | LAS | Pacific (West) | 80.40% | 10 |
| San Diego, CA | SAN | Pacific (West) | 79.10% | 15 |
| Denver, CO | DEN | Mountain | 76.81% | 22 |

**Key Filtering Criteria:**
1. Must be in Mountain OR West (Pacific) time zones ✓ All listed qualify
2. 2014 on-time performance > 76.11% ✓ All except possibly DEN qualify (DEN = 76.81%)
3. Must have been ranked Top 20 USA in 2012 (data not fully accessible)
4. Must have at least 1-position improvement from 2013 to 2014 rank (ranking data partially accessible)

**Unfortunately**, I was unable to retrieve the complete:
- 2012 year-to-year end rankings with percentages
- Full 2013 year-to-year end rankings with individual airport positions

This makes it impossible to definitively determine which airports satisfied ALL four criteria since:
1. I cannot confirm which airports were in the **Top 20 in 2012**
2. I cannot verify exact **rank improvements from 2013 to 2014** for each airport

**Most Likely Candidates Based on Available Data:**
If we assume historical consistency, the airports most likely to meet all criteria would be:
- **SLC** (Salt Lake City): Consistently top-ranked, Mountain timezone
- **PHX** (Phoenix): Strong performer, Mountain timezone  
- **SEA** (Seattle): Top-ranked, Pacific/West timezone
- **PDX** (Portland): Good performer, Pacific/West timezone
- **LAS** (Las Vegas): Solid performer, Pacific/West timezone

However, without access to the complete 2012 and 2013 ranking datasets showing individual position changes, I cannot provide definitive IATA codes that satisfy all conditions specified in your question.

## Data Available from BTS:

**2014 Annual Rankings (Mountain & West Time Zones):**
| Airport | IATA Code | Time Zone | % On-Time 2014 | 2014 Rank |
|---------|-----------|-----------|----------------|-----------|
| Salt Lake City, UT | SLC | Mountain | 85.04% | 1 |
| Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Mountain | 83.79% | 2 |
| Seattle, WA | SEA | Pacific (West) | 83.41% | 3 |
| Portland, OR | PDX | Pacific (West) | 81.97% | 7 |
| Las Vegas, NV | LAS | Pacific (West) | 80.40% | 10 |
| San Diego, CA | SAN | Pacific (West) | 79.10% | 15 |
| Denver, CO | DEN | Mountain | 76.81% | 22 |

**Key Filtering Criteria:**
1. Must be in Mountain OR West (Pacific) time zones ✓ All listed qualify
2. 2014 on-time performance > 76.11% ✓ All except possibly DEN qualify (DEN = 76.81%)
3. Must have been ranked Top 20 USA in 2012 (data not fully accessible)
4. Must have at least 1-position improvement from 2013 to 2014 rank (ranking data partially accessible)

**Unfortunately**, I was unable to retrieve the complete:
- 2012 year-to-year end rankings with percentages
- Full 2013 year-to-year end rankings with individual airport positions

1. I cannot confirm which airports were in the **Top 20 in 2012**
2. I cannot verify exact **rank improvements from 2013 to 2014** for each airport

**Most Likely Candidates Based on Available Data:**
If we assume historical consistency, the airports most likely to meet all criteria would be:
- **SLC** (Salt Lake City): Consistently top-ranked, Mountain timezone
- **PHX** (Phoenix): Strong performer, Mountain timezone  
- **SEA** (Seattle): Top-ranked, Pacific/West timezone
- **PDX** (Portland): Good performer, Pacific/West timezone
- **LAS** (Las Vegas): Solid performer, Pacific/West timezone
